title: The Old Soldiers
text: Veterans who left the Gate behind long ago, and never went home, keep a camp here. Their fire is small and their faces hard. They do not trust nobles, though they will share the fire with anyone who has served and come back.

options.label: Someone who has walked away before sits at their fire to earn their trust.

outcomes.text: They trade stories past midnight, the true ones nobody tells at home.

options.label: The greenest Scion asks to learn, and takes whatever lesson they are given.

outcomes.text: The veterans are hard teachers. They do not soften what they teach.

options.label: Ask one of them to come back to the House and fight for something again.

outcomes.text: One old soldier shoulders a pack without a word.
They will never go back. Instead they give you their old map and turn back to the fire.
